principles.title: Protein + resistance training
principles.source: Morton et al., British Journal of Sports Medicine, 2018
principles.summary: Protein supplementation augments resistance-training adaptations; meta-regression found a breakpoint around 1.6 g/kg/day, with uncertainty around the estimate.

principles.title: Low energy availability / RED-S context
principles.source: IOC Consensus Statement on Relative Energy Deficiency in Sport, 2023
principles.summary: Prolonged inadequate energy availability can impair health and performance. Athlete Life OS uses risk signals only; it does not diagnose RED-S or calculate true energy availability without FFM and exercise energy expenditure.

principles.title: Carbohydrate and resistance-training performance
principles.summary: Carbohydrate effects on resistance exercise are context dependent; benefits are more plausible with high-volume, glycogen-depleting, fasted or repeated training.

principles.title: Acute carbohydrate feeding and resistance exercise
principles.summary: Meta-analysis reported higher resistance-training volume with carbohydrate, especially in sessions over 45 min and after prolonged fasting.

principles.title: Energy surplus size in trained lifters
principles.source: Helms et al., Journal of the International Society of Sports Nutrition, 2023
principles.summary: Larger surplus did not clearly improve muscle thickness or strength compared with smaller surplus in the small trial, while faster mass gain was associated with greater skinfold gain.

principles.title: Exercise and fluid replacement
principles.source: American College of Sports Medicine Position Stand, 2007
principles.summary: Hydration needs are highly individual; sweat-rate and body-mass change are preferred for individualisation. Excessive dehydration can compromise performance, especially in demanding conditions.

engineering_notes: The app does not contain a validated equation that converts calories, water, protein or micronutrients into an exact percentage of muscle growth.
Composite 0–100 scores are decision-support heuristics that combine measured trends and evidence-informed thresholds.
Observed body-weight and waist trends are weighted more heavily than a fixed calorie target when sufficient longitudinal data exists.
True energy availability requires fat-free mass and exercise energy expenditure; the app therefore reports an under-fuelling risk signal rather than RED-S diagnosis.
Micronutrient food-log coverage cannot diagnose a deficiency; lab testing and clinical assessment are separate.
